# 90min

> > 90min is a global football news platform delivering breaking transfer rumors, match coverage, and expert opinion across multiple languages and regional editions.

90min covers all major football leagues including the Premier League, Champions League, La Liga, Serie A, and Ligue 1, with dedicated coverage of top clubs like Manchester City, Liverpool, Real Madrid, Barcelona, and Arsenal. The platform features original reporting from accredited journalists, player profiles, fixture schedules, and transfer market analysis.

## Key Topics

- Premier League
- Champions League
- Transfer News & Rumors
- Real Madrid
- Manchester City
- Liverpool
- Chelsea
- Arsenal
- Barcelona
- Juventus
- Player Profiles
- Match Predictions
- Women's Football (WSL)
- International Football
- Transfer Market

## Global Editions

- [90min French Edition](https://90min.com/fr): French edition of 90min with Ligue 1, Champions League news and transfer rumors
- [90min Brazilian Portuguese Edition](https://90min.com/pt-br): Brazilian Portuguese edition covering Brasileirão, Copa Libertadores and transfer news
- [90min Italian Edition](https://90min.com/it): Italian edition featuring Serie A, Juventus, Milan news and transfer market coverage
- [90min Main Stories & News Feed](https://www.90min.com/en-in/main-stories): Main news feed covering Premier League, Champions League, La Liga and world football

## Player Profiles & Transfer Coverage

- [Vinicius Junior](https://www.90min.com/players/vinicius-junior): Vinicius Junior player profile with latest news, transfer rumors and Real Madrid coverage
- [Philippe Coutinho](https://www.90min.com/players/philippe-coutinho): Philippe Coutinho player profile with transfer news and Aston Villa loan coverage
